title: Longest Substring Problems
definition: Classic sliding window problems requiring a Hash Set/Map to track character occurrences. Example: 'Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters'. As the `right` pointer encounters a duplicate, the `left` pointer advances until the duplicate is removed.
simpleExplanation: Reading a word letter by letter, keeping a list of letters you've seen. The exact second you read a letter you've already seen, you cut the word.
